releases.name: Tech Chaos
releases.summary: TicTacToe also known in some countries as Morpion is basically a game for 2 players represented by X and O. It is played on 3x3 grid with the aim of aligning first 3 pieces (Alignment Vertical, Horizontal or Diagonal). With a very advanced design and animated character, TicTacToeSmiley is a king of TicTacToe where basic X and O are replaced with animated Smileys for a better game experience. It's the world’s first TicTacToe offering animated smileys adapting themselves to the current game state (see screenshots). TicTacToeSmiley has 3 animated Smileys and 2 pseudo-animated ones. With a multitude of animations, these Smileys will not only adapt themselves to the current game state (loser, winner, etc ...), they are also able to dance Gangnam Style (Yeahh! ). You just need to launch the music (GangnamStyle PSY) on your device during the game (start the music player and return to the game) and they will automatically dance! Cool! The game has two modes: 1 player mode against the computer and 2 players mode. The artificial intelligence of the 1 player mode is very advanced and adapts well to different levels of difficulty (Easy, Medium, Hard). Among the features of MorpionSmiley you will find: * The animated Smileys ready to have fun during the game depending on the game state * An excellent design and sound effects. * Choose among several Smileys for every player. * A highly advanced artificial intelligence adaptable to your level (Easy, Medium, Hard). * No advertising is integrated into the app, so you can play relaxed. Have fun;).
